summary: The figure shows total alcohol consumption per capita (age 15 years or older) from 2000 to 2019 across WHO regions and globally, separated by sex. The European Region has the highest consumption levels, especially among males, though it shows a declining trend. The Eastern Mediterranean Region has the lowest consumption levels. The South-East Asia and Western Pacific Regions show increasing trends in alcohol consumption. Globally, male consumption is consistently higher than female consumption, with both sexes combined showing a slight increase over time.
